$description: Component-specific values that would otherwise be hard-coded in three places. Everything here is a decision from docs/05-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md §3, not a convenience alias.

chip.$description: SignalChip: background at 12 % of the signal colour, border at 40 %, text via contrast-color().

row.$description: DensityToggle. Collectors want to see a lot; the answer is a switch, not a compromise.

cover.$description: MatchCard cover thumbnail. Loaded by the browser straight from i.discogs.com — never server-side, that host has its own Cloudflare limit.

motion.$description: 150–250 ms for UI feedback, 300–400 ms for layout changes. Movement serves orientation and causality, never decoration.
